description: Mock Q&A for offline metrics and optional RAGAS/DeepEval runs.

samples.question: How long is the laptop warranty?
samples.ground_truth: ACME laptops include a 24-month warranty from the purchase date.
contexts: All ACME laptops include a 24-month warranty from the purchase date. The warranty covers manufacturing defects only.

samples.question: What is the return window for unopened items?
samples.ground_truth: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days for a full refund.
contexts: You may return unopened items within 30 days for a full refund. Opened items can be exchanged within 14 days.

samples.question: How do I reset my password?
samples.ground_truth: Use Forgot password on the login page and follow the email link.
contexts: To reset your ACME account password, open the login page, click Forgot password, and follow the email link.

samples.question: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees get?
samples.ground_truth: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
contexts: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

samples.question: How do I request VPN access?
samples.ground_truth: Request VPN via the ServiceNow catalog item Remote Access — VPN.
contexts: Request VPN access via the ServiceNow catalog item Remote Access — VPN.

samples.question: What is the response SLA for a SEV-1 incident?
samples.ground_truth: SEV-1 production down incidents have a 15 minute response SLA.
contexts: SEV-1 Production down Response SLA 15 minutes Resolution target 4 hours
